author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete

GO:0098742 – Cell-cell adhesion via plasma-membrane adhesion molecules -> transfer to GO:0098609 cell-cell adhesion
GO:0090674 - endothelial cell-matrix adhesion via fibronectin -> transfer to GO:0090673 endothelial cell-matrix adhesion

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30711

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1e9_J9yblNwSqOT6chIPap_8eUXMs8Ua1oXHjfRsxYVY/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
ZFIN	4
ARUK-UCL	3 - automatically updated by GOA
AgBase	1
RGD	4
UniProt	13
dictyBase	2

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to Cell-cell adhesion via plasma-membrane adhesion molecules and related terms

source_title: Obsoletion notice: Cell-cell adhesion via plasma-membrane adhesion molecules and endothelial cell-matrix adhesion via fibronectin (with replacements)
